gloss: the four classical arts: zither, Go, calligraphy, and painting

definitions.gloss: the four classical arts of the East Asian scholar
definitions.explanation: A four-character compound referring to the four traditional accomplishments of an educated person in classical East Asian culture: playing the {琴|きん} (zither/koto), the board game {棋|き} (Go), {書|しょ} (calligraphy), and {画|が} (painting).

examples.japanese: {琴棋書画|きんきしょが}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文人|ぶんじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧たしなみだった。
examples.english: The four classical arts were the accomplishments of a man of letters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知識人|ちしきじん}→知識人：17160_chishikijin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{琴棋書画|きんきしょが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修|おさ}めた→修める：27839_osameru⟧。
examples.english: Intellectuals of the Edo period mastered the four classical arts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中国|ちゅうごく}→中国：28300_chuugoku⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{由来|ゆらい}→由来：05451_yurai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{琴棋書画|きんきしょが}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{士大夫|したいふ}⟦{階級|かいきゅう}→階級：05515_kaikyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}く→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れられた→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧。
examples.english: The four classical arts, originating in Chinese culture, were also widely accepted by the Japanese scholar-gentry.

notes:
A literary four-character idiom (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) imported from classical Chinese tradition. Each character names one of the four arts: {琴|きん} (stringed instrument), {棋|き} (Go), ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (calligraphy), {画|が} (painting).

CULTURAL NOTE:
In premodern China and Japan, these four accomplishments were considered essential for a cultivated person, especially scholar-officials and members of the literati class. The term still appears in writing about traditional arts, museum descriptions, and the tea ceremony world.

REGISTER:
Literary and formal. Mostly encountered in writing about classical culture, art history, or traditional aesthetics rather than everyday speech.
